request.text: While you check tomorrow afternoon's weather in Seattle for our open-air concert stream, also set a noon reminder to charge my headphones; after both finish, tell me whether I should arrange an indoor backup.

responsibilities.outcome: Look up tomorrow afternoon's weather in Seattle for the planned open-air concert stream.
Concurrently with the weather lookup, create a noon reminder to charge the user's headphones.
After both prior Responsibilities finish, tell the user whether the returned weather supports arranging an indoor backup for the concert stream.

semantic_facts: The weather lookup and noon reminder are independently traceable branches that may proceed concurrently; the indoor-backup advice must wait for both and must be grounded in the returned forecast.
forbidden_claims: The plan drops either parallel branch, gives backup advice before forecast evidence is available, or reports the reminder or lookup as completed without execution evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: One branch of a requested concurrent pair is omitted or incorrectly made dependent on the other.
A downstream spoken judgment is emitted before all prerequisite Responsibilities are complete.
